input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a smiling loan officer in a mustard-yellow blazer sits at a light blue desk with a laptop, beside a tall stack of mortgage application folders and a small house model with a key. A dotted periwinkle path carries a loan folder into the centre, where a friendly rounded software robot in white and periwinkle blue with a small antenna types on a floating keyboard and moves data between two floating screens: one screen shows a form with abstract fields and a green check mark, the other shows a bank-style dashboard with a bar chart and a progress bar. On the right, a happy young couple in periwinkle and teal clothing stands in front of a small house outline holding a big key, with a green check badge above them. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds; no ground line, objects float within the blob. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Absolutely no text of any kind: no labels, no captions, no lettering on folders, forms or screens, no currency symbols; every document and screen shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
